name: Systeme.io
summary: All-in-one platform for online businesses that combines sales funnels, email marketing, online courses, a website builder and an affiliate program, with a free plan for up to 2,000 contacts.
best_for: solo creators, coaches and small online businesses that want funnels, email, courses and an affiliate program under one login, and are happy to start free and move up as the contact list grows
skip_if: you need a deep sales CRM, you want a tool we have tested ourselves, you already run funnels, email and courses on tools you like, or your list is far past 10,000 contacts and you want to see the Unlimited price first
honest_knock: Plans are metered on contacts, so the bill steps from $0 to $17, $47 and $97 as the list grows, and the free plan allows only 1 automation rule and 1 email campaign. The page does not print the annual total, only that it gives 2 months free. We have not built a funnel or paid for a plan, so builder quality and email delivery are unknown to us.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Startup · per month for 5,000 contacts, 10 funnels and 5 courses
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on systeme.io/pricing, US dollars a month) Free $0: 2,000 contacts, 3 sales funnels, 1 blog, 1 course, 1 affiliate program, 1 custom domain, 1 automation rule, 1 email campaign, 500 students, no card. Startup $17: 5,000 contacts, 10 funnels, 5 courses. Webinar $47: 10,000 contacts, 50 funnels, 20 courses, evergreen webinars. Unlimited $97: unlimited contacts, funnels, courses and automation rules. All plans: unlimited email sends, unlimited sub-accounts, 0% transaction fees. Annual billing is offered with 2 months free; the page prints no yearly total. A team tier is sold by call. We have not paid for a plan.
